title: Single-Node 8-GPU HGX (H200/B200) vs. Multi-Node 400G/800G RDMA vs. Rack-Scale Supernode (GB200/GB300 NVL72) Selection, Liquid Cooling Boundaries & 3-Year TCO Guide

tiers.tier: Tier 1: Dual-Node 16x H100 (80GB) over Legacy Unoptimized Network (Cross-Node Bottleneck)
tiers.recommended_scenario: Legacy 80GB HBM clusters unable to fit 671B FP8 inside a single 8-GPU node

tiers.tier: Tier 2: Single-Node 8x H200 (141GB, 1.13TB HBM3e) Compact Appliance (Zero Cross-Node Traffic)
tiers.recommended_scenario: Best fit for existing air-cooled enterprise datacenters (<20 kW/rack) deploying private 671B FP8

tiers.tier: Tier 3: Multi-Node 32x HGX B200 + 400G/800G RDMA (PD Disaggregation + DeepEP Dual-Batch Overlap)
tiers.recommended_scenario: Modular high-throughput scale-out cluster for standard enterprise AI factories

tiers.tier: Tier 4 (Flagship): GB200 / GB300 NVL72 Rack Supernode (72-GPU 1,800 GB/s NVLink 5 Copper Backplane EP=72 + NVFP4)
tiers.recommended_scenario: DLC liquid-cooled (>120 kW/rack) AI factory flagship delivering 8.07x Goodput/GPU and $0.12/1M tokens
